name: PGH Pest Control
description:
PGH Pest Control is a UK pest control company covering Surrey and the surrounding counties, treating wasp and hornet nests, rodents, bed bugs, fleas, moths, cockroaches, squirrels, moles, birds and more, alongside surveys and proofing work.

This connector books real appointments. Your assistant reads PGH's live service list with current prices including VAT, asks the same qualifying questions the website asks, and checks genuine diary availability for your postcode — only offering slots a technician can actually attend. When you choose one, it confirms the exact price and PGH's terms, holds the slot, and hands you a Stripe checkout link.

You complete payment yourself on Stripe's page: the assistant never sees or handles card details, and nothing is charged through the conversation. Once you pay, PGH emails your confirmation and the visit is in the technician's diary. If you decide not to pay, the reservation releases itself automatically at no cost — there is nothing to cancel.

Jobs that cannot be priced responsibly online — larger or unusual infestations, protected species, commercial contracts — are routed to a survey or a phone call instead of a guessed price. Cancellations, refunds and rescheduling are handled by the PGH office on 01483 273478.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PGH Pest Control to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PGH Pest Control to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pgh-booking-mcp.charlie-4be.workers.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is PGH Pest Control MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, PGH Pest Control scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PGH Pest Control MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PGH Pest Control provides these MCP tools: pgh_get_slots, pgh_list_services, and pgh_reserve_slot.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PGH Pest Control?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PGH Pest Control in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does PGH Pest Control MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: PGH Pest Control does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
PGH Pest Control is developed by PGH Pest Control. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
